components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only button variant carrying the brand fill — the default call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #fff); font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)) 90%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -10px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)) 55%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.55 0.2 291)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border, no resting fill, keeps violet reserved for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: var(--color-background, #fff); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.55 0.2 291)) 50%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; border-radius: 25px; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-foreground, #000) 6%, transparent); padding: 14px; transition: transform .3s ease-out, box-shadow .3s ease-out; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 24px 48px -12px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)) 18%, rgba(0,0,0,0.75)); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-heading, Manrope); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; } .ds-card-sub { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-card-price { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--font-heading, Manrope); color: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-price-symbol { font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 0.06em; transform: translateY(-0.03em); }

components.name: Badge — Default
components.description: Standard status/merchandising badge — violet fill, full capsule.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #fff); font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Badge — Best Value (Gold)
components.description: The one exception to the single-accent rule — Honor Gold is reserved exclusively for this badge.
components.html: Best Value
components.css: .ds-badge-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-gold, oklch(0.8 0.14 83)); color: var(--color-gold-foreground, oklch(0.28 0.06 70)); font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-gold svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field used across checkout and admin forms — hairline border, violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: transparent; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 16px; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.55 0.2 291)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.55 0.2 291)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link — animated underline grows on hover instead of a background or color change.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 2px; background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-position: 0% 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 0% 1px; transition: background-size .3s ease-out, color .3s ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); background-size: 100% 1px; }

components.name: Price
components.description: The signature price treatment used everywhere a price appears — deliberately the loudest text on the card.
components.css: .ds-price { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; font-family: var(--font-heading, Manrope); color: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.5 0.223 291)); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 0.92; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-price-symbol { font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 0.06em; letter-spacing: -0.015em; transform: translateY(-0.03em); display: inline-block; }

narrative.overview:
BudgetWise reads as a polished digital trading counter for game items: price-first, trustworthy, fast, and restrained. One signature color, Deep Electric Violet, carries the brand across every surface — from the price of every item to the primary call to action to the header's focus ring. Honor Gold appears in exactly one place, the Best Value signal, so its rarity keeps doing the work of "this one's worth noticing" instead of decorating.

The mood is polished, approachable, and quietly confident, with just enough warmth to feel right for a young gaming audience rather than corporate. Today's implementation leans into that with rounded cards, soft ambient shadows, a glass-blurred header, and an animated shimmer sweep on the Messenger CTA and the "Best Value" badge — a storefront working hard to look and feel more trustworthy than the resale-market norm. The stated direction for future refinement is to keep that trustworthy, tactile confidence while pulling back on decoration: crisper edges, fewer competing glows, less visual noise, without losing the "premium, not sterile" feeling that makes a budget-priced reseller credible.
keyCharacteristics: One brand color (violet) does almost all the color work; gold is a single, non-repeatable signal.
Cards and surfaces read as "expensive" through soft shadow and gentle lift, not through heavy borders or bright fills.
Manrope (headings, prices) paired with Geist Sans (body) — a confident geometric display voice over a quiet, legible body voice.
Generous corner rounding (14–25px on primary surfaces) throughout; nothing sharp-cornered by default.
Motion is purposeful and sparse: a staggered hero entrance, a hover lift on cards, a shimmer sweep reserved for the two moments that most need attention.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Honor Gold appears in exactly one role (Best Value) at a time. Do not introduce a second gold usage; its scarcity is what makes it legible as "this one is different."

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Outside of status colors (destructive red) and the one gold exception, every accent moment — links, focus, prices, primary buttons, active nav — is the same Deep Electric Violet. Don't introduce a second general-purpose brand hue.

rules.name: The Price Voice Rule
rules.body: Every price on the site uses the same extrabold, tabular-numeral treatment in the primary violet — a price should be instantly recognizable as a price before it's read, never styled as plain body or heading text.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Where a shadow signals interactivity (button hover, card hover), mix in the brand violet rather than using a neutral gray shadow — depth and brand identity are the same visual event, not two separate systems.

rules.name: The Restraint Direction
rules.body: New decorative elevation (extra glow layers, additional blur surfaces, stacked gradients) needs a real reason tied to a specific important moment — it is not the default treatment for an arbitrary new card or section.

dos: Do keep Deep Electric Violet as the only general-purpose accent — prices, primary actions, focus states, and links all share it so the brand reads as one deliberate color, not a palette.
Do keep Honor Gold to exactly one meaning (Best Value) across the whole product.
Do tint interactive shadows with the brand violet (color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) …)) rather than reaching for neutral gray shadows.
Do pair a Taglish caption with new English customer-facing copy, styled per the Taglish Caption component.
Do keep corners generously rounded (14px minimum on any primary surface) — nothing in this system should read as sharp-cornered.
donts: Don't add a second brand hue or a second use for Honor Gold — scarcity is the point of both rules.

Don't stack additional glow, blur, or gradient decoration onto a surface by default; reserve shimmer/glow treatments for moments that already carry one rather than extending the pattern to new elements.
Don't give a secondary/outline/ghost button a colored resting fill — the primary button must stay the only "this is the action" signal on a given screen.
Don't treat the manual Messenger/GCash order flow's current mechanics as a permanent brand feature to visually reinforce — it is today's implementation, not the system's identity.
